title: Leading as the coach
summary: Asked how much he controls the band, Herman says he is the coach, comparing himself to Woody Hayes and Vince Lombardi.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Woody, when you manage your band as a leader, I think

there's interest in to what degree you are the boss of the band. That is, you are a straw boss or how much control do you exercise in the musical direction, or do the writers who contribute to the book help to move it in a certain direction, because your decisions are always involved in that, I know.

Well, I think the best way to describe my position, it's the same one I started with a long time ago. I'm the coach. I really honestly sincerely believe I'm the best coach that there is in the entire music business. Anymore than Woody Hayes would think he was the best coach in college football or the late -- who was the great coach from Green Bay whom I had such respect for?
Italian name. Whatever his name was, I once received --
